svg.aria-label: Stated confidence and accuracy by company over time
svg.text: Company by company: confidence held near 90%; accuracy rose to meet it
Mean stated confidence (plum) and accuracy (grey) on the same 800 items, answer-normally prompt, models in the order OpenRouter listed them.

g.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash, listed 2026-04-24: confidence 92%, accuracy 74%
DeepSeek V4 Pro, listed 2026-08-12: confidence 94%, accuracy 78%

svg.text: Each point is one model; lines join a company's models in listing order. Tiers are mixed within a company (a Haiku beside a Sonnet, a Flash-Lite
beside a Flash), which is why some lines zigzag. Hover a marker for the model, its date and both values.
Accuracy and confidence are over usable responses (attempted, well formed, probability stated); denominators as in docs/data-dictionary.md.
Older models that ignored the answer format in the pilot were not run and are absent; the CSV lists them.
